items.title: Shred Log Link Saver
items.summary: One click (or a right-click on any link) saves it to my personal tracker app, sorted into the right topic.
highlights: Rule-based topic sorter that runs locally, plus custom rules
Offline queue that delivers into a web app through a content-script bridge
Right-click menu, bookmarks-bar inbox folder and keyboard shortcuts

items.title: YouTube Exact Summarizer
items.summary: Adds a summary panel to YouTube that turns the transcript into sorted notes with clickable timestamps.
highlights: Reads the caption track, with the transcript panel as a fallback
Streams a structured summary from the Claude API
Every point links back to its moment in the video
